pappa

pappa, pappae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

food, in a baby’s word

In this lexicon

  • yum yum

    also used · classical · Varr. ap. Non. 81 (Lewis & Short s.v. pāpa)

Notes

  1. 1pappa: double p, short a (Lewis & Short pāpa, with pappa as a variant). The spelling of the verb pappō (Lewis & Short; Pers. 3.17) and of Varro’s fragment in the Latinitas loci text (pappās, Non. p. 81): the heavy first syllable is written with the double consonant, as in mamma. Cf. Italian pappa, baby food.
